body: before dawn: the crop trial crew brought rinsed gloves. my brother started coughing. I washed everything twice before the county van arrived.
title: Before dawn: rinsed gloves

body:
He wanted the room cleared before he opened his bag. We moved the chairs into the hall and he put three envelopes on the table.

The first was for the people still here. The other two had names of places already shut. He took those away when I asked him why he had come so late.

I thought he would leave a copy. Instead he asked for the empty envelopes back, too. The chairs are still in the hall because no one knows whether the room is open.
title: What the messenger carried
